name: saas-analytics-dashboard
context: Design a data analytics dashboard with interactive charts, filterable date ranges, and exportable reports. The audience is product managers and growth teams who need to track user engagement, conversion funnels, and revenue metrics over time. Target platforms: desktop (primary) and tablet landscape. The interface must handle large datasets gracefully, support chart type switching, and provide meaningful empty/loading states.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json scale for metric labels, values, and axis text
Apply color.rules.json data visualization palette (min 5 distinguishable colors with 3:1 contrast between adjacent series)
Charts must not rely solely on color: use patterns, labels, or shapes as secondary differentiators
Layout must use layout.rules.json grid with responsive card placement
Loading states must use skeleton patterns with Motion_Library shimmer preset
Date range picker must support presets (7d, 30d, 90d) and custom range
Comply with Quality_Gate: meaningful chart titles, no orphaned legends, proper data density

outputCriteria.format: Analytics dashboard spec with chart components, filter controls, metric cards, data tables, and responsive grid layout
qualityChecks: Chart colors use data visualization token palette with sufficient contrast
Every chart has a descriptive title and optional subtitle for context
Loading skeletons match final layout dimensions to prevent CLS
Filter controls persist selection state visually using action tokens
Export actions are accessible but visually secondary to primary data
accessibilityRequirements: All charts include accessible descriptions via aria-label or structured data table fallback
Data series distinguishable without color via patterns or direct labels
Date picker is keyboard operable with proper ARIA calendar role
Metric changes announced via aria-live when filters update
Chart tooltips are accessible to keyboard and screen readers

examples.description: Revenue chart card with date filter, line chart, and legend
examples.output:
Organism: ChartCard
  bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
  border: var(--border-default)
  radius: var(--radius-lg)
  padding: var(--space-lg)
  Children:
    - Molecule: ChartHeader(flex, justify=space-between)
        - Atom: Heading(level=h3, token=typography.heading.sm, text='Revenue over time')
        - Molecule: DateRangeFilter
            - Atom: Button(variant=ghost, label='7d')
            - Atom: Button(variant=ghost, label='30d', aria-pressed=true, bg=color.surface.active)
            - Atom: Button(variant=ghost, label='90d')
    - Molecule: LineChart(height: 280px, aria-label='Revenue trend line chart')
        series: [{ color: var(--color-data-1), pattern: solid }]
        axis-y: token=typography.body.xs, color=color.text.tertiary
        axis-x: token=typography.body.xs, color=color.text.tertiary
        gridLines: var(--color-border-subtle)
    - Molecule: Legend(flex, gap=space.md)
        - Atom: LegendItem(color=color.data.1, pattern=solid, label='Total Revenue')
  LoadingState:
    - Atom: Skeleton(height=280px, radius=radius.md, motion=shimmer)
acceptanceCriteria: Chart uses data visualization token palette (color.data.x)
Date filter buttons indicate active state with surface.active token
Chart includes aria-label for screen reader identification
Loading state uses skeleton with Motion_Library shimmer preset
Axis text uses smallest typography scale token
